title: Glass Is Not a Slow Liquid
hook: Old windows are thicker at the bottom, but glass is not a liquid.
script: Old windows are thicker at the bottom, but glass is not a liquid. The popular story says glass slowly creeps downward over the centuries. If that were true, ancient Roman glass would be badly drooped by now. So why are old windows uneven? Panes were made by hand, spinning molten glass into a flat disc. The disc came out thicker at the edge, and builders often set that heavy edge at the bottom. So what is glass, if it is not a liquid? It is a solid whose atoms froze in a jumbled pattern, never lining up into crystals.
